system.description: A narrow stretch of sea lies beneath the Curtain to Yrdalun’s east. A bay drinks in the river Findalos, and a harbor clings to the shore where the river meets the sea. It yet bears the scars of Vaith’s great failure, its marble buildings stained and its cobblestones cracked. Brave souls venture out to fish in the waters, though the catch is not always wholesome.
